reviews.title: Inconsistent
reviews.text: I’ve been paying for a subscription for several years. App HAD been a very useful tool and must have for this swim parent. This past year 2025-2026 this app has not earned its keep and I’ll be looking for a better tool.

reviews.title: Never up to date
reviews.text: I have to use this app for two or three events a year. It is always inaccurate never up-to-date and makes the app subscription useless. The whole point of the subscription is to be able to keep up with the meat. If you cannot keep up with the Meet, then the subscription is not useful. I see people saying that it is because the information is not updated by the officials at the meet. That is an app problem if you’re going to use the app and requires a subscription then you need to have safeties in place to make sure Meet officials keep everything updated. Or you cannot charge.

reviews.title: Unable to login, not worth the paid subscription
reviews.text:
The app stopped recognizing my username and password, despite having an active paid subscription. The reset password link never was sent to my email despite multiple attempts. Emailed support but have not heard back.   
It’s very frustrating and not worth the money.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: I only use this because I’m forced to.

reviews.title: Active Passport login system - poor quality
reviews.text:
Terrible experience. I have an active paid annual subscription, but I can’t even log into the app. To make things worse, after introducing the ridiculous Active Passport login system, the password reset doesn’t work either.

I’m paying for a service that I can’t access. This should have been tested before forcing users to migrate to a new login system. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: Intrusive useless login screen on every app launch
reviews.text: Introduced an intrusive useless login screen on every app launch. That login screen broke notifications.

reviews.title: Annoying alerts….
reviews.text: It’s so annoying when I’m trying to look at results and the host team is dumping a bunch of results in and it keeps interrupting and not allowing me to look at results because the pop ups keep freezing the screen.

reviews.title: Unbelievably slow
reviews.text:
I’ve used this app for years and it’s one of the only apps I have that has progressively gotten slower and more difficult to use over time. When switching between events, the app constantly freezes or takes 10-30 seconds (or occasionally minutes) before it allows me to choose another event. 

I love this app but recently it feels like I’m using internet explorer. It’s so horribly slow and the amount of time I spend watching the wheel spin saying “please wait” is usually longer than I spend checking actual events. It’s a shame.

reviews.title: Lag and delays
reviews.text:
The app has a ton of lag. In the last update, when going to events, you can’t scroll down the events until you wait for 10 seconds or so. 

When it flags that a favorite team is swimming, clicking the notification takes you to the team list of swimmers with no way to navigate to what meet it is. 

I’d be embarrassed to be the developer of this app with all the clunky operations.

reviews.title: So buggy and inaccurate
reviews.text: This app is the death of the swim world. It is inconsistent, inaccurate on at least 40% of the results, late in its reports, and just overall terrible. The developers need to get with the times. At this point, just spend the money on a heat sheet and jot down your swimmer's times. A complete waste of money.

reviews.title: Way too slow
reviews.text: I have used this app for a few years, and to my surprise it has a 5‑star rating, seriously? Normally, I would rate it 3 stars for basis functions, but today it deserves only 1 star. This weekend I needed to use it for my kids, and each click/touch took a couple of minutes to display the information that I needed. This is not workable and not acceptable. Please fix it as soon as possible.
